purpose: Static educational low-poly catalog candidate; independent QA/GPU/scene/release are separate.

criteria.description: Validate final static GLB/project/Khronos, source reopen, two real queued semantic rebuilds and all measured transformed components.

Inspect every512px final frame after exact triplet binding; open silhouettes, solid volumes and no visible coplanar interference. Correct generated concept: two giant pods at a shoot tip are inaccurate. Use16 small narrow carpels along each open distal axis; eight paired stamen stalks lower. Make leaf division genuinely three-level, reduce the too-thick main stem and swollen bases, and keep roots sparse.

Slender herb with four ascending terminal fertile shoots, one modest primary root and four short secondary roots. No woody trunk. 12 leaves are three-level divided fans, larger basal leaves on longer petioles and swollen bases. Each has27 fine rounded ultimate segments. Each open elongated fertile axis bears16 stalked folded carpels distally and8 paired-stamen stalks below. No petals, sepals, bracts, floral cups or modern water-lily flowers. Choose Sun2002 A.sinensis organismal interpretation. Aquatic habit and phylogenetic placement remain debated as reviewed by Doyle/Endress2014. Four shoots and12 leaves are artistic simplification, not counts asserted for holotype J-0721. No claim of earliest angiosperm, exact life color, pollen microstructure or opened seeds.
Preserve original freeze and inventory. Verify complete source/generator/config/dependency closure and all numeric semantics.
Parse exact GLB with pinned Three GLTFLoader.

Requires actual intended composed scene with scale/contact/runtime evidence.

scale.interpretation: Nominal artistic whole-object targets, not hard thresholds. No global scale normalization is allowed. Source-constrained organ ranges below are hard; other dimensions are nominal design inputs.
scale.accuracy: Interpretive educational geometry, never an exact fossil cast.

origin: Geometry minimum z0; horizontal bounds centered. Translation only, no global scaling.
surface_profile: Opaque flat-faceted full-volume geometry. No textures, alpha planes, emission, double-sided concealment or subdivision.
numeric_semantics: All per-organ parameters defined here before generator authoring. Source range measurements are hard only where enumerated. Integer counts are mandatory authored design choices, not universal fossil counts. Nominal lengths/radii without hard-range entries remain artistic; actual final values must be measured and disclosed.
component_measurement_contract: Tag every stem, branch, leaf/petiole, root, scale and reproductive unit. Reopen actual Blend and measure its transformed vertices after grounding/centering. Per component: vertex/face/triangle count, world AABB and local-axis length/width/thickness; compare hard organ ranges. Record authored/evaluated/exported counts.
contact_policy: Every supporting junction must have actual child-base mesh vertices embedded in the named parent component. Measure nearest parent surface signed distance from actual child-base vertices in world space using parent triangle BVH, not declared config points. Preserve diagnostic directions and inspect all attachment regions. Mere AABB overlap is not proof.
